Name: Foggy Grouse
Author: jakee417
Description:
[i][b]Fog and smoke[/b][/i] have descended upon Pelican town, and with it, came a [i][b]noisy flock of grouse[/b][/i]! The grouse's incessant hooting are driving folks mad, you have to knock them out of the sky with a slingshot to get it to stop. A nice reward is waiting if you can get 50 grouse 🎁.

[youtube]cRZfZQroxEI[/youtube]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jakee417/Fog-Mod/refs/heads/main/nexus/install.png[/img]
Install the latest version of SMAPI.
Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Run the game using SMAPI.

﻿﻿[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jakee417/Fog-Mod/refs/heads/main/nexus/how_to_use.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Find a tree with a grouse in the foggy forest (﻿listen for hooting and check for a small grouse head)
[*]Spook the grouse from a tree (shake or hit with tool)
[*]Shoot it with a slingshot
[*]Grab the egg (optional)
[*]Check the adventure guild a reward after 100 grouse!
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jakee417/Fog-Mod/refs/heads/main/nexus/troubleshooting.png[/img]
Please post issues [url=https://github.com/jakee417/Fog-Mod/issues]here[/url].

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jakee417/Fog-Mod/refs/heads/main/nexus/compatibility.png[/img]
- Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
- Works in single-player and multiplayer. It can safely be installed by any player (host or farmhand), even if other players don't have it.
- No known mod conflicts.
